Jordan (Finance): Heads-up: temporary budget guidance for the next 6 weeks. We expect a soft freeze on new uncommitted spend in Q3 planning window. What that means: no new vendor contracts > $10k without Finance + FP&A sign-off. Exceptions below. :warning:

Sam (Finance Ops): Practical rules: 
- Corporate card OK for ad-hoc purchases < $1k.
- Travel authorizations for any trip > $500 require pre-approval via TravelOps form.
- Submit expense reports within 10 days of transaction or the card will be suspended for repeat late filers.

Priya (Travel): Adding per-diem reminder: domestic meals cap $75/day, international follows country table (link in TravelOps). If your trip is customer-facing and requires higher limits, request an exception when you submit pre-approval.

Ava (Eng): What about vendor proofs-of-concept (eval access to GPUs) typically $3k? Need PO?

Jordan (Finance): If it's a time-limited eval under $5k and vendor is already approved, you can use the card. If you expect renewal or multi-month spend, route for a PO. Also tag expenses with project_code and deployment_tag (e.g., project_code=RED-DED, deployment=private).

ProcurementBot: Auto-notice: New requirement: any new vendor with access to infra or data must be onboarded as Tier A (security questionnaire + SOC docs). Sandbox vendors used only for internal POCs may be Tier B at Procurement discretion. See https://intra.redwood.com/procure/vendor-tiers for details.

Marta (People Ops): People Ops note for managers: hiring-related purchases (candidate travel, laptop procurement for new hires) are allowed but please flag as "hiring" in the request so we can track against hiring budgets.

Sam (Finance Ops): Emergency exceptions: if an emergency purchase is needed to unblock production and exceeds thresholds, escalate to oncall-finance@redwood.com with subject "PROC EMERGENCY" plus invoice estimate. We'll fast-track approvals during business hours. After-hours: ping finance Slack rotation.

Ava (Eng): Got it — will file pre-approval for the cloud bench evals. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Finance): TL;DR: temporary soft freeze on new uncommitted contracts > $10k, keep small buys on card (< $1k) with tags, travel pre-approval > $500, onboard infra/data vendors as Tier A. We'll post an FAQ and host a 30-min drop-in next Tuesday 10:00am for questions. Thanks everyone.
